title: HuSS Scorer
description: Semi-automatic, offline scorer for HuSS (Human-Scaled Section) drawings. It aligns scanned sheets, suggests the figure, ceiling and wall, lets a rater confirm or correct, and merges, reports and compares the results. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript; runs in the browser; images and data never leave the computer.
notes: Documents, specification, paper template and example data: CC BY 4.0.
